post.title: Perfect-highly recommended! – dollyface99
post.html: I have never written a review before but felt the need to this time. We have been staying here while visiting family (under sad circumstances unfortunately) and we couldnt have chosen a better place. Its gorgeous- the photos dont do it justice! We stayed in Skylark and it was huge, quiet and kitted out with everything you need. The bed was mega comfy and the shower was really powerful!!Lovely underfloor heating made it so cosy but reckon it would be cool in the hot summer months too. The games room was out of this world- although we didnt use it we had a peek- it has snooker, table tennis, table football, darts, tv, computer games, boards games, millions of books…..all in an amzing barn building. And the views were spectacular! The owners have been great- really accomodating and helpful which was excatly what we needed- we have been staying there on and off for the last month. And some of the cottages allow dogs too- some lovely walks around that our dog loved! We cant recomend this place, or the owners, enough. Great for romantic getaways, holidays with friends, business stays etc. We will definitely be back for a holiday in the future!
